children: Enterprise AI software maker's fiscal Q1 revenue slightly beat analyst expectations
Company posted positive free cash flow and narrowed non-GAAP operating loss
Bookings increased 73% quarter over quarter following restructuring and expense controls
C3.ai expects Q2 revenue between $51 mln and $55 mln
Company sees full-year 2027 revenue at $210 mln to $240 mln
C3.ai targets non-GAAP operating loss of $123 mln to $155 mln for fiscal 2027
SALES RESTRUCTURING - Co said restructuring of sales organization contributed to improved bookings and operational performance
NEW AGREEMENTS - Co closed 22 agreements with customers including Ford, Johnson & Johnson, and several U.S. government agencies
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 1 "strong buy" or "buy", 7 "hold" and 6 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for C3.ai Inc is $9.00, about 13% below its September 1 closing price of $10.34
